newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar mixed in PM, NY dulls sentiment.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar mixed in PM, NY dulls sentiment.

text.p: Bearish sentiment in New York dragged London white sugar futures lower on Friday afternoon after a morning where trade buying had dragged nearby whites back towards this week's support levels.
Spot August nudged higher to stand 60 cents higher on the day at $320.00 by 1608 GMT, still off its intraday high of $320.80.
But other forward months were lower and the nearby August/October spread widened further to a nominal $6.00. October was down 30 cents at $314.90 and overall volume reached 1,209 lots.
"The trade do need to buy August," said one trader. "I think they've waited too long...and they're having to pay up for it."

But August still needs to gain another couple of dollars to regain its average value from two weeks ago, before one leading commission house persistently sold the position for what was believed to be speculator clients.

In New York, the spot July contract expires at close of business on Monday although traders said they expected a hefty posting of against actuals business would reduce the large open interest still outstanding.
Paris futures followed a similarly mixed trading pattern to London. August was up 50 cents at $320.00 while October was down by the same amount at $315.00.
Matif volume totalled a light 281 lots.
